title: 1986. Minimum Number of Work Sessions to Finish the Tasks

examples.explanation: You can finish the tasks in two work sessions. - First work session: finish the first and the second tasks in 1 + 2 = 3 hours. - Second work session: finish the third task in 3 hours.
You can finish the tasks in two work sessions. - First work session: finish all the tasks except the last one in 3 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 8 hours. - Second work session: finish the last task in 1 hour.
You can finish all the tasks in one work session.
